description: Paper 3 design 1 (spec §6 'Variant emergence', ~2,000 runs): within-voyage evolution and detection of novel norovirus / SARS-CoV-2 lineages. Mutational supply is swept in both regimes — a diversity arm (multi-genotype embarkation, 1-4 founders, nominal rates) and an emergence arm (single founder, per-transmission and within-host rates over ~2 decades) — crossed with voyage length so detection is reported as a timescale. Hourly clock, drawn-incubation arm, with a paired fixed_onset control tier.

surveillance_tier_notes.inv_baseline: Spec §4 Baseline: syndromic sick-call only, no sequencing.
surveillance_tier_notes.inv_minimal: Spec §4 Minimal: clinical qPCR/amplicon typing via the cascade.
surveillance_tier_notes.inv_moderate: Spec §4 Moderate: cascade + Nanopore verification + amplicon wastewater with lineage deconvolution.
surveillance_tier_notes.inv_full: Spec §4 Full: Moderate plus surface sampling and a deeper, long-read wastewater library.
